title: judicata verifier output
description: What one verifier run returns for the one blocker it got: a verdict, a one-line reason and, for refuted, the counter-evidence. Paths are relative to the project root.

verdict.description: verified: the blocker is real. refuted: concrete counter-evidence shows it is wrong. inconclusive: you cannot decide from what you can read.

counter_evidence.description: Only for refuted, at least one entry: a quote from a file in scope that handles the case, or a passing approved command with a line of its output. A refutation without valid counter-evidence counts as inconclusive.

kind.description: quote (with file, line, quote) or command (with criterion, output).

file.description: quote: path of a file in the contract's scope, relative to the project root.

line.description: quote: 1-based line number the quote starts at (within 5 lines).

quote.description: quote: verbatim text from the file at that line.

criterion.description: command: the id of a command criterion that ran and passed in this round.

output.description: command: text copied verbatim from that command's output that shows the case is handled.
